findings.title: Portable brief gave a nonpositive-equity reason for an overflowing ratio with positive equity
findings.reproduction: Use a zero-FCFF subnormal fixture with cash=Number.MIN_VALUE, no debt or other claims, pre-money quote 150, primary capital 30 and holder fraction 0.1. The modeled equity residual is positive 5e-324, but its price-gap ratio exceeds finite numeric range. The original brief incorrectly called the equity nonpositive and omitted the numeric-range warning.
findings.resolution: The brief selects the reason from the actual signed equity residual and carries the calculation warnings into its method section.
findings.verification: The dedicated presentation regression checks the exact numerical-range table label and warning while rejecting nonpositive-equity text. Separate zero/negative cases retain the appropriate nonpositive explanation.

findings.title: A finite ratio became unavailable when presentation multiplied it by 100
findings.reproduction: Use the same zero-FCFF fixture with cash 1e-306. Its priceGapPercent is finite 1.5e308; multiplying that fraction by 100 overflows the JavaScript number range, previously yielding an unavailable percentage in the UI and brief.
findings.resolution: The shared formatter scales the exponent directly for finite ratios whose percentage conversion would overflow. Small positive and negative currency amounts also use scientific notation rather than appearing as zero.
findings.verification: Focused regressions verify positive/negative 1.500e+310 percent formatting, percentage points, tiny signed currency, the brief row and exact companion JSON ratio.

findings.title: Copying modeled equity could replace a valid large post-money round with a precision-limited input

reproduction.observedBoundary: The current pre-money price 1000 is valid. Copying the small positive modeled equity residual into this post-money quote produces a candidate below the subtraction precision boundary.

findings.resolution: The internal modeledRound helper runs the complete proposed round through financingLens. Both the button availability and its click handler use that validated candidate.
findings.verification: The reviewer inspected both call sites. The separately authored final Chromium suite confirms the original pre-money price 1000, a disabled modeled-equity copy action and an unchanged exact shared snapshot, with zero page errors.
